_meta.description: Priority routes the user flies every year, with every gateway and the programs that can book each leg. Search all gateways, not only the user's usual ones. Gateway service is from the destination airport's Wikipedia 'Airlines and destinations' table (re-check with the wikipedia-airports skill when stale). No award prices here: prices are dynamic and must come from live searches.
